title: Access requests
subtitle: People who signed in with Google and asked for access as leader or mentor. Only the administrator approves mentor requests.
hasLeader: This location already has a leader: {{name}}. Approving replaces the current leader.
replaceConfirm:
{{unit}} already has the leader {{current}}.

Replace with {{name}}? The current leader loses access.
replacedReason: Replaced by {{name}} as the location leader.
refusePrompt:
Decline {{name}}'s request?

Optionally write the reason (they will see it):
unitNotFound: Location not found (it may have been deleted).
secondConfirm:
{{unit}} already has the leader {{current}}.

Add {{name}} as 2nd LEADER (both stay)?

OK = 2nd leader · Cancel = see the replace option
otherMentorUnit: Unit of another mentor: they approve this part.
leftOut:
These units were left out: {{units}}.

Each unit's mentor can add the person later in the Leaders tab.

extra.title: Requests for another unit
extra.subtitle: Leaders who asked to lead one more unit. Each mentor approves their own units.
extra.refusePrompt:
Refuse {{name}}'s request to lead {{unit}}?

If you want, write the reason:
extra.alreadyLeader: This person was already a leader of {{unit}}. The request was closed.

exits.exitsSubtitle: People who said they are no longer part of it. Their access is already off. If it was a mistake, undo it.
exits.undoConfirm: Undo {{name}}'s exit? The person gets the previous access back.
exits.undoMentorOnlyAdmin: Only the administrator can undo a mentor's exit.
exits.undoneBusy: Exit undone, but these units already have other leaders and were left out: {{units}}. Add the person later in the Leaders tab.
exits.onlyAdmin: Only the administrator handles a mentor exit.

teacher.title: Teacher requests
teacher.subtitle: Approving enables the teacher login. You link their classes afterwards, in the teachers list.
teacher.approved: {{name}} approved. Now link their classes in the teachers list.
